Subject: Request: Rapid engagement scan + manager action approvals (confidential)

Team —

I ran the follow-up to the July engagement pulse this morning and attached a redacted scan that flags ~14 people across Eng and Product who meet our high-risk criteria (combines low manager sentiment, consecutive 1:1 declines, and recent lateral churn in peer cohort). This is confidential — please do not forward outside the leadership group.

Quick summary:
- 8 folks in Eng (3 senior ICs in infra, 2 PMs, 3 in platform)
- 4 folks in Product (mix of mid/senior PMs)
- 2 in Go-to-Market (AMs flagged for workload + quota stress)

Ask: I need approvals on two items by EOD Monday so managers can start outreach next week:
1) Use of the Rapid Retention fund up to $40k total to make targeted offers where managers believe it will materially change trajectory (guidance/parameters in the attached cheatsheet).
2) Permission for People Ops to run manager-facilitated engagement 1:1 templates (attached) and to collect anonymized follow-up notes for quality checks (kept in HR vault).

Proposed immediate steps if we greenlight:
- Priya: coordinate manager briefing + scheduling (30-minute standing block template)
- Managers: use template and copy leadership thread with summary of outreach outcomes after 2 weeks
- My ask to you: quick sign-off or a one-sentence concern so we can move.

I recognize this touches compensation/precedent — if you prefer a quick 20-min sync, put your available windows on my calendar and we’ll do a short approval call.

Attachments: 2026-08-01_attrition_scan_redacted.xlsx; manager_action_templates_v2.docx; retention-rapid-approvals-cheatsheet.pdf

Thanks —
Kimberly
Kimberly Park | VP, People Success | Redwood Inference

Kimberly — thanks for the concise summary and the redacted scan. A couple quick notes:
- I support limited use of the Rapid Retention fund for clear, short-term fixes where the manager has a concrete plan (rule of thumb: < $10k per individual unless VP sign-off).
- Before any offers go out, I want Finance looped to confirm runway impact and Legal for any change-in-compensation language (we should avoid creating implied ongoing expectations).

Can Priya coordinate a 20-minute slot Monday afternoon with Finance and Legal? If we can get a 20-min cross-functional clearance, I’ll give a provisional OK so managers can begin templated outreach.

On the documentation side: please keep the raw list in the HR vault (no Slack copies). For the leadership update, a two-paragraph anonymized summary is sufficient.

Thanks — looping People Ops next steps and proposed process below. (Apologies for the long note.)

Process I recommend:
1) Approvals call (20 min) — Finance + Legal + VP approval (Vivek or Kimberly) to confirm thresholds.
2) Manager briefing packet + 1:1 template (we will train managers on language and escalation triggers).
3) Manager outreach window (2 weeks) using the template; managers submit a one-page anonymized summary after outreach.
4) HR triage: if there are signals beyond retention (bullying, manager competency), we escalate to People Ops case team.

I will schedule the approvals call for Monday 3:30–3:50pm PT (tentative) and invite Finance (Michael Grant) and Legal (Markus Klein). If that window does not work, propose another 30-min slot between 3–5pm.

Two notes on confidentiality and data hygiene:
- All raw spreadsheets will live in an encrypted People Ops folder with access limited to People Ops and the VPs mirrored on this thread.
- We will redact employee IDs and only share manager summaries in leadership updates.

Attachments sent to the thread: updated manager_action_templates_v2.docx (with suggested scripting) and the quick cheatsheet for approvals.

Priya Natarajan
